subject.title: feat(agents): Swarm core — collector spawn, agents_wait, structured output, caps (gated)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this v1 Swarm core contract—including `tools.swarm`, per-agent overrides, collector persistence, and new tool semantics—as the supported core direction after the wait-path repair and live proof?
rationale: This is a broad new core orchestration and configuration surface; code review cannot decide its long-term product/API ownership or support commitment.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded v1 core
options.body: Accept the gated core direction once the targeted wait lookup repair and real runtime evidence establish safe behavior.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Retain only the minimal collector primitive and defer configuration, persistence, or tool-surface portions until their owners agree on a smaller API.

options.title: Keep the program issue as design-only
options.body: Defer this implementation until the canonical Swarm program has explicit product sign-off for the core contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded v1 core
recommendation.body: Accept the gated core direction once the targeted wait lookup repair and real runtime evidence establish safe behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked canonical Swarm proposal and the implementation history identify steipete as the closest available routing candidate for the intended v1 boundary.
